title.tagline: pixiv finds the art · X follows the artists it finds

tags.heading: Discovery — pixiv tags
tags.hint: Every artwork carrying one of these tags is pulled. Matching is exact: 申鶴 and 申鶴(原神) are different tags, and fullwidth（）will not match.

terms.heading: X match terms
terms.hint: X has no character search and no character tags. These terms filter the timelines of artists already found on pixiv — they do not discover anything on their own.

bookmarks.label: Minimum bookmarks
bookmarks.note: Skipped artworks stay marked with the value that skipped them, so lowering this later re-opens them.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.lead: {tag} · newest first · confirm this is the right character

suggestions.heading: Suggested tags
suggestions.lead: Ranked from the tags co-occurring in the preview results — frequent for this character, rare for the others. Franchise tags rank themselves out.
suggestions.empty: add a pixiv tag to see suggestions
suggestions.refresh: Suggestions refresh after every crawl from the tags observed on this character's posts.

estimate.line: Backfill will fetch up to {n} artworks · {time} at the current rate

errors.name: a display name is what the gallery shows
errors.noTags: at least one pixiv tag: without it there is no discovery source
errors.allFullwidth: every tag uses fullwidth（）— none will match
